user.title: Volkswagen Connect
user.description: Log in with your Volkswagen ID. You'll get an email verification code (OTP) for the volkswagen.de data source — enter it on the next step. (Optional/experimental: also enable a 15-minute EU Data Act request at https://eu-data-act.drivesomethinggreater.com.)

otp.title: Two-factor code
otp.description: Volkswagen emailed a verification code for the volkswagen.de data source (battery, charging, odometer, service, warning lights, image). Enter it here. You can cancel to skip it, but then no data is available yet.

reconfigure.title: Volkswagen Connect
reconfigure.description: Log in again to restore the connection. You'll get a fresh email verification code (OTP) for the volkswagen.de data source — enter it on the next step. Use this if live data stopped with a 'session expired' message.

error.not_authorised: This account isn't set up on the Volkswagen data portal yet. Open https://eu-data-act.drivesomethinggreater.com in a browser, sign in, accept the consent screen, link your car and turn on a continuous 15-minute data request, then try again.
error.throttled: Too many sign-in attempts — Volkswagen has temporarily blocked logins for this account. Wait about 30 minutes and try again.
error.account_locked: Your Volkswagen account looks locked or disabled. Sign in at volkswagen.de to sort it out, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Volkswagen. Please try again.
error.invalid_otp: That verification code was not accepted. Check the latest email and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong during login. Please try again; if it keeps failing, enable debug logging and open an issue.

abort.account_mismatch: Please log in with the same Volkswagen account you set up originally.
